parameters.query:
with notes as (
  select v.release_id, v.task_id, v.ordr, btrim(v.release_note) as note,
         coalesce(ra.name, 'Other') as area,
         coalesce(ra.ordr, 2147483647) as area_ordr
    from agile.vw_release_plan_rows v
    join agile.agile_cache a on a.id = v.task_id
    left join agile.release_areas ra on ra.id = a.release_area_id
   where v.customer_visible and nullif(btrim(v.release_note), '') is not null
), rel as (
  select s.id, s.label, nullif(btrim(s.goal), '') as goal,
         coalesce(s.deployed_on, s.shipped_on) as shipped
    from agile.vw_release_summary s
   where s.state = 'Shipped' and exists (select 1 from notes n where n.release_id = s.id)
   order by coalesce(s.deployed_on, s.shipped_on) desc nulls last, s.id desc
   limit 3
), areas as (
  select n.release_id, n.area, min(n.area_ordr) as area_ordr,
         jsonb_agg(n.note order by n.ordr, n.task_id) as notes
    from notes n join rel r on r.id = n.release_id
   group by n.release_id, n.area
)
select r.id as release_id, r.label, r.goal, to_char(r.shipped, 'Mon FMDD, YYYY') as shipped,
       (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('area', a.area, 'notes', a.notes) order by a.area_ordr, a.area)
          from areas a where a.release_id = r.id) as areas
  from rel r
 order by r.shipped desc nulls last, r.id desc
